comparison_evidence: Query surface is a soft, compliant, fibrous paper tissue.
Silicone grippers leverage high-friction viscoelastic interaction which adapts exceptionally well to fibrous and compliant surfaces.
Gecko adhesive pads require flat, rigid, smooth contact and suffer performance degradation on compliant porous paper surfaces.
recommendation_summary: The silicone gripper is recommended because the query object features a compliant, textured, fibrous paper surface that is well-suited for high-friction silicone pads. In contrast, the rigid gecko pads rely on dry adhesion which is less effective on soft, fibrous, and porous materials.
